name: Toast
description: A brief, non-blocking message about something that just happened. A toaster (the region) shows toasts created from data, stacked, timed and paused on hover and focus; Livewire triggers them from the server. Rendered on its own, a Toast is static.

livewire.name: toast
capabilities: toaster renders the region; $this->dispatch('toast', …) from a Livewire component, and toasts flashed to the session, show in it

react.name: Toast
capabilities: Toaster renders the region; toast.create({ … }) shows one

vue.name: Toast
capabilities: Toaster renders the region; toast.create({ … }) shows one

props.name: color
props.description: Tints the icon. Emitted as data-color. error makes the toast an alert.
props.a11y: error sets role=alert, so it's announced at once.

props.name: variant
props.description: inverse uses the inverse surface, for a toast that must stand out. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: surface
props.description: The toast's surface. Emitted as data-surface. Glass falls back to the overlay surface under reduced transparency and in high contrast.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name from the registry. Defaults to the color's status icon: circle-check, triangle-alert, circle-alert or info. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons under the text, such as Undo. In a toaster, a toast with an action doesn't dismiss itself.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Dismiss notification' ).
props.a11y: The close button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…', actions: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The toast: role status, or alert for errors.

parts.name: closeTrigger
parts.description: The close button: a ghost, neutral, small icon-only Button.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The close button was pressed. In a toaster the toast also dismisses itself; on its own, hiding it is the owner's job.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the toaster's region.
Moves through the toasts' actions and close buttons.
On a toast in a toaster, dismisses it.

requirements: The toaster's region is a labelled landmark (role=region, translatable "Notifications") with aria-live=polite; an error toast is role=alert, announced at once.
A toast times out after its duration (default 5000ms), paused while the region is hovered or focused; duration 0 keeps it.
Toasts with actions don't dismiss themselves (WCAG 2.2.1).
Never the only place an error is reported: blocking errors use Alert.
The close button has an accessible name (translatable, "Dismiss notification").
Text keeps 4.5:1 on the overlay, inverse and glass surfaces; the icon tint is --apui-color-<c>-text.
The region sits at the bottom end of the viewport and mirrors in RTL.
